sourceProfile.scope: InceptionD only; no complete Inception network
sourceProfile.shape_origin: explicit static module profile; not observed

sourceFacts: Bounded AST adapter reads actual attribute order, kernels, stride/padding, list order and nested cats.
Every BasicConv is Conv(biasFalse) -> BN(eps.001) -> inplace ReLU; real .conv/.bn attributes own independent parameters.
Four or three source paths receive the same x; lists are collected and then channel concatenated.
Repeated initial BasicConv bodies in the five-block path remain folded at detailed view; all operators and identities remain in IR.

endpoint_projections.reason: expanded operand/fork scope is supplied by individual producer edges

sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
